promptTemplate: A close environmental view of a powerless electrical control area inside an underground public facility immediately after a blackout. Several large digital displays are completely black. Electrical control panels and indicator arrays are completely dark. A nearby advertising screen is black and powerless. The ceiling is outside the frame. The only visible powered light source is one dim red emergency beacon, casting a weak red glow onto dark powerless equipment. No person is present. The unmistakable visual subject is loss of electrical power.

Large puddles collect on the asphalt and reflect muted storefront lights. Water streams along the gutters. The street feels still, vacant and quiet under the rainfall. The weather phenomenon is the clear visual subject.
